title: Figure 16: antihydrogen atom diagram (antiproton and positron)
description: Simple atomic diagram of a blue antiproton at the centre of an elliptical orbit with a yellow positron, labelled "antiproton," "positron" and "stable antihydrogen atom." Captioned "Figure 16. Antihydrogen Atom." It opens "Appendix C: Antimatter Annihilation Rocket," followed by text on electron-positron and proton-antiproton annihilation for propulsion.
